annotations.title: A circle of a radius around a point

description: A true circle of a given radius around a point as a GeoJSON polygon (correct on the ellipsoid, across the antimeridian). Use for "everything within 50 km of" map shapes. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

antimeridian.description: split (default, RFC 7946: cut at ±180° into a Multi- geometry, crossing points solved exactly) or unwrap (one geometry with longitudes past ±180°, for web maps that pan across the date line).

decimals.description: Decimal places on coordinates, 4-9 (default 7, about 1 cm).

format.description: json (default: the answer with a "geojson" Feature) or geojson (the Feature alone, Content-Type application/geo+json, ready for a map).

inputFormat.description: Skip auto-detection of the input format.

order.description: For letterless numbers: latlon (default) or lonlat.

radius.description: Radius in "unit" (more than 0, up to 10000 km).

ref.description: Reference point for short plus codes in the input, like "40.4,-79.9".

unit.description: Unit of the distances you send: m, km (default), mi, nmi, ft.

name: geodesic_circle
title: A circle of a radius around a point
